data.name: Storm
data.gender_notes: Storm is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Storm is recorded in name-lists as “Swift and powerful”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Storm expresses “Swift and powerful”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Storm total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_latin.name: Storm
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen est tempestas, violentus, furiosus, turbulentus. Origo nomen storm a tempestate, violenta, furiosa, turbulentia. Nomen storm est nomen latino, quod significat tempestas violenta vel furiosa.
